segments.name: Heat-pump replacement aftermarket
segments.thesis: Replacement share and installed base create exact-model parts/control demand.
segments.replacement_pressure: Very High (33% of sales are replacements)
segments.niche: Heat pump controllers, remotes, Wi-Fi modules
segments.supplier_gap: Few good online sellers; existing merchants inadequately resolve controller selection

segments.name: Remote cottage monitoring
segments.thesis: Large geographically concentrated free-time-home stock may support remote frost/water/power/connectivity monitoring.
segments.supplier_gap: Generic monitoring doesn't address Finnish cottage-specific needs

segments.name: Exact-model EV aftermarket
segments.thesis: Traficom model/geography data can define exact cohorts before merchant/query tests.
segments.supplier_gap: Generic EV accessories don't address specific model compatibility

segments.name: Building thermal diagnostics
segments.thesis: Large detached-home stock plus few visible Pocket2 offers supports validation of a decision-support tool.
segments.supplier_gap: Generic tools don't address Finnish building-specific thermal issues

segments.name: Professional pipe inspection
segments.thesis: Sparse comparison offers warrant hidden-channel and dealer validation for RIDGID.
segments.supplier_gap: Professional equipment hard to source in Finland
